statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) = m, and for every i with 0 <= i < m, writing x = queries[i][0], y = queries[i][1], and S_i = { j | 0 <= j < n and nums1[j] >= x and nums2[j] >= y }, we have: if S_i is empty then r[i] = -1; otherwise r[i] = max { nums1[j] + nums2[j] | j in S_i }.
